# Shri Prasanna Pattnaik Memorial Trust (SPPMT)

> Official website of the Shri Prasanna Pattnaik Memorial Trust (also known as the Prasanna Patnaik Trust / Sri Prasanna Patnaik Memorial Trust), a nonprofit charitable trust established in 2025 in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.

For comprehensive information, complete biography, and full entity dossier, see:
- Full dossier: https://sppmt.org/llms-full.txt

## Tax-Exempt Donations (Section 80G)

The trust accepts voluntary community contributions eligible for tax deduction under Section 80G of the Indian Income Tax Act. Official signed receipts are provided for all eligible contributions.

- Donate Page: https://sppmt.org/donate
- Bank: UCO Bank, Saheed Nagar, Bhubaneswar (Account: 09230210004593, IFSC: UCBA0000923)
- UPI ID: shriprasannapattnaik.82380414@hdfcbank (HDFC SmartHub Vyapar)
- Tax Benefit: 50% deduction under Section 80G
- Receipt SLA: Within 7 working days upon submitting PAN and transaction details

## About Shri Prasanna Pattnaik (1948–2025)

Shri Prasanna Pattnaik (also spelled Prasanna Patnaik; 1 June 1948 – 30 May 2025) was a prominent social worker, legislator, and the first BJP MLA of Odisha:
- 1977: Elected youngest MLA in Odisha's legislative history from Kamakhyanagar at age 28 (Janata Party).
- 1985: Elected as the first BJP MLA in Odisha's history from Kamakhyanagar, recognized as Leader of the BJP in the Odisha Assembly.
- Institutions Founded: Kamakhyanagar College, Anchalika Mahavidyalaya (Bhuban), rural high schools, sub-divisional hospitals, blood bank, and the Brahmani Setu bridge.
- Full Biography: https://sppmt.org/founder

## Primary Focus Areas

1. Education: Educational kits, scholarships for underprivileged rural students, school mentorship (https://sppmt.org/activities/education).
2. Healthcare: Health camps, generic medicine support, elderly care outreach (https://sppmt.org/activities/healthcare).
3. Skill Development: Vocational training, youth and women livelihood programs (https://sppmt.org/activities/livelihood).
4. Agriculture: Sustainable farming practices, crop diversification (https://sppmt.org/activities/livelihood).
5. Civic Sense & Environment: Cleanliness drives, tree plantation, public hygiene awareness (https://sppmt.org/activities/cleanliness).
